CheckTitle: Do not setup access keys during initial user setup for all IAM users that have a console password
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks for console users that have active access keys which have never been used (keys created at user setup).
Risk: Keys created by default at user creation are often never needed, are forgotten and later leaked.

Recommendation.Text: Do not create access keys during console user setup; delete never-used keys.
